newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: First Holdings opens printed circuit plant.
newsitem.headline: First Holdings opens printed circuit plant.

text.p: First Philippine Holdings Corp said on Friday it had opened a flexible printed circuits manufacturing plant in the northern Philippines.
Printed circuits are small, light wiring components used for electronic parts like hard disk drives, cameras and computer printers.
The 800 million-peso plant is a joint venture with Sumitomo Corp.
The company is projecting annual revenues of more than 1.3 billion pesos in the initial years of operation.
